concepts.label: UPDATE STATISTICS ... DELETE / ANALYZE ... DELETE STATISTICS (delete-statistics syntax)
concepts.note: no prior term in registry; one of several syntactic forms of the UPDATE STATISTICS statement

relations.subject: n1ql:update-statistics-delete
relations.note: structural link; page explains the functional effect of this statement in terms of the cost-based optimizer
relations.evidence: Since the [cost-based optimizer](cost-based-optimizer.md) uses statistics for cost calculations, deleting statistics for a set of index expressions effectively turns off the cost-based optimizer for queries which utilize predicates on those expressions.

relations.subject: n1ql:update-statistics-delete
relations.note: structural link from existing Markdown Related Links list

notable_absence.finding: Unlike statistics-index.md and statistics-indexes.md, which both carry an identical WITH-clause option table (sample_size, resolution, update_statistics_timeout, batch_size), this delete-statistics syntax has no WITH/USING clause at all — it only has a DELETE clause. This is a structural asymmetry among the four UPDATE STATISTICS sub-syntax pages worth noting for the ontology (not every sibling shares the same option surface).
